title: Senior Staff Developer, User Identity & Access Management (UIAM)
descriptionHtml:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

High Level Role Overview

As a Senior Staff Developer for User Identity & Access Management (UIAM), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of our identity platform, which serves as the foundation of trust for our Fortune 100 customers and their nonprofit partners. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will combine hands-on full-stack engineering with architectural leadership to design and scale secure authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycles using tools like Auth0, Okta, and Ping. In our fast-paced, AI-assisted development environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver highly reliable, zero-trust identity solutions while mentoring peers and fostering a culture of inclusive, high-performance engineering.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide technical leadership for UIAM by architecting the evolution of our identity platform including authentication SSO and authorization

  • Design secure and scalable identity capabilities on public cloud platforms leveraging Auth0 as the core for human and M2M clients

  • Make AI a natural extension of your engineering practice to increase velocity and quality through secure AI-assisted development lifecycles

  • Partner with security teams to embed zero-trust least-privilege and secure-by-design practices aligned with modern identity standards

  • Collaborate closely with product managers to translate complex business and customer identity requirements into actionable technical specifications

  • Balance concurrent deliveries by making sound prioritization decisions that keep diverse teams aligned and unblocked

  • Mentor senior developers through practical hands-on examples and constructive feedback to foster an inclusive engineering culture

  • Create clear architectural documentation and promote industry-standard tools that improve agility and time to market

  • Build thoughtful proofs of concept to validate new identity access approaches and drive continuous product advancement

  • Participate actively in architectural reviews to ensure high quality consistency and alignment with our north-star architecture

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ years of scalable software development experience with at least 2 years in a technical leadership role driving platform modernization

  • Deep expertise in identity and access management including OAuth 20 OpenID Connect SAML JWT and SSO federation

  • Hands-on experience with Auth0 tenant architecture and custom actions alongside familiarity with Okta Ping and SCIM provisioning

  • Strong software architecture skills with an API-first approach utilizing loosely coupled systems and domain-driven design

  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming with a strong focus on Java and Python using frameworks like Spring Boot and FastAPI

  • Extensive cloud-native experience across AWS and GCP encompassing Infrastructure-as-Code DevSecOps and modern CI/CD pipelines

  • A strong security mindset focused on threat modeling least privilege secrets management and comprehensive audit logging

  • Experience with domain-driven database design and building high-availability low-latency data access for authorization decisions

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to author clear architecture decision records and thoughtfully influence tool adoption

  • Comfort thriving in a fast-paced agile environment leveraging AI-led development practices while gracefully navigating ambiguity

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a company where DEIB isn’t a buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.
